theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_minimizing_summand
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity (T - T₁) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T₁.massOn W + (T - T₁).massOn W ≤ T.massOn W) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → (T - T₁).massOn W ≠ ∞) → IsMinimizingIn T₁ A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
